cases.question: root_count
cases.problem: 方程式$x^2-5x+6=0$の実数解の個数を求めよ。
cases.proof:
have h := (root_count_by_discriminant 1 (-5) 6 (by norm_num)).1 (by norm_num)
have e : {x : ℝ | x^2-5*x+6 = 0} = {x : ℝ | 1 * x ^ 2 + (-5) * x + 6 = 0} := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor <;> intro k <;> linarith
rw [e]
exact h
